mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, growth_stage, personality, updated_at, chara_image_url FROM ai_growth WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_growth ( user_id, name, growth_stage, personality, updated_at, chara_image_url ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{growthStage}, #{personality}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{charaImageUrl} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_growth SET name = #{name}, growth_stage = #{growthStage}, personality = #{personality}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, chara_image_url = #{charaImageUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_growth SET growth_stage = #{growthStage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.rank_id AS "rankId", u.total_purchase_amount AS "totalPurchaseAmount", r.rank_name AS "rankName", next_rank.rank_name AS "nextRankName", next_rank.min_amount AS "nextRankMinAmount" FROM users u INNER JOIN ranks r ON r.id = u.rank_id LEFT JOIN ranks next_rank ON next_rank.min_amount = ( SELECT MIN(r2.min_amount) FROM ranks r2 WHERE r2.min_amount > u.total_purchase_amount ) WHERE u.id = #{userId}
